semiconductor_relevance: High — Kempur Microelectronics specializes in photoresists, which are critical materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kempur Microelectronics, a Chinese-Foreign joint high-tech company, develops, manufactures, and sells photoresists in China. With a strong focus on advanced analysis and functional testing, the company is positioned to support the semiconductor industry with high-quality materials.

regional_presence.China: Kempur is the only photoresists company capable of developing, manufacturing, and selling photoresists in China.
